messages.subject: Indexing samples in merged data
parts:
Hi again,
now that i have successfully managed to use Cardinal::combine to merge my samples and preprocess them together, I want to run further analyses, but separately for each sample, e.g. with the Clustering and PCA functions. While I have figured out how to index the image matrix with imageData(merged_data)[features(merged_data,mz=...),,,samplenr], the Cardinall functions do not require the image data, but the whole MSI data structure as input. So I was wondering if there is a way to index differently or something like an inverse to the Cardinal::combine function that allows to split the data structure again?
I'd be grateful for any input on this!
Thanks!

messages.author: 6033d3c0e7d242fa
messages.subject: Re: Indexing samples in merged data
parts:
The entire data structure can be indexed like a matrix, where rows are features (m/z features) and columns are pixels (spectra).

For example, if you are working with MSImageSet:

s1 <- pData(mydata)$sample == "sample1"
mydata_sample1 <- mydata[,s1]

or if you are working with MSImagingExperiment:

s1 <- run(mydata) == "sample1"
mydata_sample1 <- mydata[,s1]
